storyboard.learning_objective: See why 1 + 3 + 5 + … + 11 = 6² by wrapping L-shaped layers around a square.

beats.name: layer_1
beats.description: Add the L-shaped layer of 1 cells
beats.caption: Start with 1 square

beats.name: layer_2
beats.description: Add the L-shaped layer of 3 cells
beats.caption: Add 3 squares: now 2 × 2 = 4
beats.narration: Wrap 3 more squares around it to make a 2 by 2 square of 4.

beats.name: layer_3
beats.description: Add the L-shaped layer of 5 cells
beats.caption: Add 5 squares: now 3 × 3 = 9
beats.narration: Wrap 5 more squares around it to make a 3 by 3 square of 9.

beats.name: layer_4
beats.description: Add the L-shaped layer of 7 cells
beats.caption: Add 7 squares: now 4 × 4 = 16
beats.narration: Wrap 7 more squares around it to make a 4 by 4 square of 16.

beats.name: layer_5
beats.description: Add the L-shaped layer of 9 cells
beats.caption: Add 9 squares: now 5 × 5 = 25
beats.narration: Wrap 9 more squares around it to make a 5 by 5 square of 25.

beats.name: layer_6
beats.description: Add the L-shaped layer of 11 cells
beats.caption: Add 11 squares: now 6 × 6 = 36
beats.narration: Wrap 11 more squares around it to make a 6 by 6 square of 36.

beats.name: result
beats.caption: The first 6 odd numbers make 6²
beats.narration: Adding the first 6 odd numbers always gives a perfect square: 6 squared.
